_readme: Drone profile library for GeoCad UAV Toolkit.
IMPORTANT, read before trusting these numbers:
* v_max_ms and endurance_min are transcribed from manufacturer
specifications. Those are best-case figures (no wind, ideal
temperature, new battery). Real survey endurance is routinely 25-35 %
lower. rth_reserve_pct exists to absorb that; the planner only ever
uses endurance_min * (1 - rth_reserve_pct/100).
* climb_ms and descent_ms are deliberately NOT the airframe maxima. They
are conservative *planning* rates (spec default 4 / 3 m/s): a survey
aircraft following terrain while shooting does not climb at its full
rate, and planning at the maximum would produce a profile the aircraft
cannot actually hold with the gimbal stabilised. Raise them only if
your own practice supports it.
* waypoint_limit is the practical limit of the controller/app, not of the
aircraft, and it varies by firmware and app version. Verify it against
the app you actually fly with before relying on the mission split.
* turn_radius_m is 0 for multirotors (they can pivot in place). For fixed
wing it must be set from your own bank angle and cruise speed:
R = v^2 / (g * tan(bank))
Clone any entry and edit it; a user file merges on top of this one.

wpml (optional) declares the aircraft to DJI's own waypoint format. Without it this plugin refuses to write a WPML mission for the profile, because the file has to name the aircraft and the payload by DJI enumeration value and inventing one would produce a mission the aircraft may reject or, worse, fly wrongly. The values are in DJI's Cloud API documentation under 'Product Supported': 'Enumeration Values of Aircraft, RC and Dock' gives type/sub_type, 'Enumeration Values of Camera' gives type-subtype-gimbalindex. Only the enterprise aircraft DJI lists there can fly WPML at all -- the Mini, Air and Phantom consumer series cannot, whatever values are put here.

drones.name: Autel EVO II (generic)
drones.source: Autel EVO II series specification (approximately 38-40 min depending on variant)
drones.notes: Variant-dependent. Confirm endurance and payload against your unit.

drones.name: DJI Air 3
drones.source: DJI Air 3 specification (46 min max flight time)

drones.name: DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise (M3E)
drones.source: DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise specification (45 min max flight time, 21 m/s S-mode)
drones.notes: Endurance is the manufacturer hover/ideal figure; survey endurance is lower.

wpml.source: DJI Cloud API, Product Supported: Mavic 3 Enterprise Series (M3E Camera) 0-77-0, Mavic 3E Camera 66-0-0

drones.name: DJI Mini (1)
drones.notes: Classe sotto i 250 g. Nessuna missione a waypoint nativa sul firmware: la rotta si vola con un'app di terze parti (Litchi) o a vista. Niente WPML, che DJI riserva alle serie enterprise.

drones.name: DJI Mini 2
drones.notes: Classe sotto i 250 g. Nessuna missione a waypoint nativa: rotta via Litchi o a vista. Niente WPML.

drones.name: DJI Mini 3
drones.source: DJI Mini 3: sotto i 249 g, 34 min con la batteria standard, 16 m/s
drones.notes: Classe sotto i 250 g con la batteria standard. Con la Intelligent Flight Battery Plus l'autonomia sale a 47 min ma il peso supera i 250 g e la classe cambia: per quella configurazione usa il profilo dedicato.

drones.name: DJI Mini 3 Pro
drones.source: DJI Mini 3 Pro: sotto i 249 g, 34 min con la batteria standard, 16 m/s
drones.notes: Classe sotto i 250 g con la batteria standard. Otturatore elettronico. Niente WPML: DJI lo riserva alle serie enterprise.

drones.name: DJI Mini 3 Pro (batteria Plus)
drones.source: DJI Mini 3 Pro con Intelligent Flight Battery Plus: 47 min, 16 m/s
drones.notes: Con la batteria Plus il peso supera i 250 g: non e' piu' la classe sotto i 250 g e cambiano gli obblighi. Il peso indicato e' quello dichiarato per questa configurazione; verificalo sulla tua macchina prima di volare.

drones.name: DJI Mini 4 Pro
drones.source: DJI Mini 4 Pro specification (34 min with the standard battery)
drones.notes: Sub-250 g class. Electronic shutter: keep the ground speed low.

drones.name: DJI Phantom 4 Pro V2
drones.source: DJI Phantom 4 Pro V2.0 specification (30 min)

drones.name: DJI Phantom 4 RTK
drones.source: DJI Phantom 4 RTK specification (30 min, 50 km/h P-mode)
drones.notes: RTK/PPK. Camera centre is offset from the GNSS antenna; TimeSync handles it.

drones.name: Ala fissa generica
drones.source: Conservative planning defaults, not a specific airframe
drones.notes: turn_radius_m 60 m corresponds to about 16 m/s at a 25 deg bank: R = v^2/(g tan(bank)). Recompute for your aircraft.

drones.name: Multirotore generico
drones.source: Conservative planning defaults, not a specific airframe
drones.notes: Starting point when the real airframe is not in the library. Edit before flying.
